text:
marta: Postmortem follow-up: quick plan to harden rollouts after the tenant incident. Short bullets below for owners + dates.
sam: 👍 I'll take the auto-rollback controller. Plan: prototype + simulation mode, PR by Fri.
li: I'll own blast-radius gating and migration for existing flags. Will draft config and migration steps.
ryan: I'll add signals + dashboard tiles. Suggest triggers: 5xx >0.5% for 3m, p95 >2x for 5m, cross-tenant error spikes.
tess: I'll build a synthetic smoke-run that gates beyond 5% ramp. If smoke fails, hold/rollback automatically.
security-team: Kill-switch should live in Vault with an RBAC role and audit log. Recommend 2-person approval for global kill.
marta: Proposed deadlines: sam 2026-04-01, li 2026-03-30, ryan 2026-04-03, tess 2026-04-02, security-team 2026-03-31.
sam: API sketch for auto-rollback (simulation mode):
POST /rollouts/:id/auto_rollback
{ "enabled": true, "simulation": true, "conditions": ["500_rate>0.5%"], "grace_period_s": 180 }
li: Blast-radius example: {"max_users":1000, "max_hosts":10, "max_percentage":5}
marta: I'll create tickets and link to the postmortem. Quick sync Thu 10am to hand over. React :thumbsup: when you accept.
ryan: :thumbsup:
li: :thumbsup:
tess: :thumbsup:
security-team: acknowledged
deploy-bot: rollout-controller v2.1.1 deploy succeeded.
